three_actual_prefix_closures.scope: Exact continuation of these actual fixed prefixes with three remaining ANDs; not all rank-two/rank-three or arbitrary scalar prefixes.

separate_closure_audit.scope: All three actual fixed five-gate spaces and exactly three further ANDs. Exact closure exclusions only; not all rank2/rank3 prefixes or unrestricted8-AND GF16/AES.
separate_closure_audit.first_product_kernel_completeness: For each fixed left, multiplication followed by reduction outside S is linear in right coefficients. A full row-equation nullspace basis spans every right giving a product in S. Its image modulo W is zero iff every eligible right product is already in W.
separate_closure_audit.rank_tight_applicability: A valid three-product completion must enlarge W13 to S16, so every suffix truth lies in S and contributes an independent quotient direction. With no first useful product, no such completion exists. Zero-preserving normalization removes affine constants without losing a representative.

rank_three_family_inventory.scope: Complete products from canonical shared-product P whose high-degree parts lie in H(P), modulo the available quadratic span. Interpretation as a family-wide obstruction requires the separate rank argument.

separate_rank_three_family_replay.family_argument: For any invertible linear input substitution mapping Q modulo affine into a four-dimensional quadratic target space whose every nonzero polar has rank8, a useful in-envelope product would give a quadratic residue outside span(p,Q). Its entire coset modulo(p,Q) has polar rank>=6 because target combinations outside Q have rank8 and p has rank2. The complete canonical product inventory gives a representative of rank<=4 for every eligible product. Contradiction. Thus P is product-closed within P+target and cannot complete in three ANDs.
